charter.thesis: gate-crash trades Crash 1000 Index on M5. Its strongest condition is that the body as a fraction of the bar's whole range is at or above 1, which fires on 75% of bars and has averaged +2.045R. A setup counts when 5 of its 6 conditions hold (tier A). Measured over 383 trades at -0.1523R each. These conditions reproduce the policy's own decisions with 1% balanced accuracy on held-out bars - below that the charter would be describing something the agent does not do. It chooses its own stop from {0.75x, 1x, 1.5x, 2x, 3x} ATR and its own target from {1:1, 1:1.5, 1:2, 1:3, 1:5}. It may also close or tighten a running trade early. It can never size a position, set a risk percentage or override a halt - there is no action for any of those.
charter.exit_rule: may close all or part of a trade, or tighten its stop, on a closed bar; never widens a stop and never sizes a position
